name: UNID Company Ltd.
summary: UNID Company Ltd. manufactures and sells potassium based chemical products in South Korea and internationally. The company manufactures and sells chemical products, including potassium hydroxide, potassium carbonate, hydrochloric acid, and liquid chlorine. The company also produces and supplies steam, hot water, and electricity, and engages in commodity brokerage, forest development, and afforestation projects. In addition, it manufactures and sells battery materials and chemical products, as well as operates steam and power generation businesses.
